import.title: The imported content differs from the existing file
import.desc: The {{target}} produced this time by {{source}} doesn't match the existing file in the folder — it may have been edited by hand, cleaned up by AI, or changed in Excel.
import.draftWarn: This file is open in the editor with an unsaved draft — overwriting will put your draft in conflict with the new content.

preview.badge: Read-only preview — the original is untouched, nothing written to disk
preview.overLimit: Over the 100,000-row limit — read-only preview of the first 1,000 rows
preview.confirmDesc: xlsx files can't be edited directly. Confirm to generate the corresponding CSV next to it and open it for editing; the original xlsx stays untouched, and the two are independent from then on.

canonical.title: File isn't in canonical CSV format

csv.exportOverLimit: For oversized tables, ask Oru to handle them before exporting
csv.provMulti: Multiple scripts claim to write this file: {{scripts}} (ambiguous origin; consider tidying up)
csv.overLimit: Table exceeds the 100,000-row limit — read-only preview of the first 1,000 rows; ask Oru to process it
csv.emptyTable: Empty table — start with a header row
csv.replaceAllTip: Replace every match at once; undo with ⌘Z. Headers are not replaced.
csv.pasteTooBig: Pasting would exceed the 100,000-row limit, so nothing was pasted. Ask Oru to handle data this large.
csv.pasteHidden_one: {{count}} of {{total}} pasted rows is hidden by the current filter
csv.pasteHidden_other: {{count}} of {{total}} pasted rows are hidden by the current filter
csv.tooManyValues: Too many values — showing the first {{cap}}
csv.gbkDesc: This file uses GBK encoding. Saving will convert it to canonical UTF-8 format; encoding detection can be wrong, so if unsure, save a copy and leave the original untouched.
csv.bomDesc: This file is UTF-8 with a BOM. Saving strips the BOM and converts it to canonical format; if unsure, save a copy and leave the original untouched.
